slide.text: AI improves title intake quality and processing speed
For the FCT, AI adds value when it reduces repetitive document handling, improves consistency, and still leaves the final decision in the hands of authorized reviewers.

text.p: Title-related workflows can spend too much time re-entering parcel references, applicant details, and supporting-document content by hand.
High-volume mass-housing or regularisation activity makes it harder to maintain intake consistency across desks.
That increases the risk of slower queue progression, weaker verification quality, and more manual back-and-forth.
Uploaded PDFs and images can be parsed to prefill forms, helping FCT teams process more files with greater consistency.
Side-by-side verification lets reviewers compare extracted content with the original evidence before approval or correction.
Field provenance stays visible, so officials can distinguish human input from AI-assisted suggestions inside the audit trail.

slide.text: The procurement value is controlled acceleration: better throughput, cleaner records, and stronger verification discipline.
